jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Mental Health, Tenure-Track, Social Work
jobs.description: Baylor University Diana R. Garland School of Social Work seeks to fill a full-time, tenure-track faculty position in mental or behavioral health. Rank is at Assistant Professor, and the position starts in August 2027. Successful candidates for this faculty position will contribute to the school's mission of educating students in Garland School programs and advancing research in mental health, while also engaging in meaningful service and collaboration with colleagues in the school. This position is based in our Waco residential program. Candidates should possess an earned research doctorate, an enthusiasm for the mission of the Diana R. Garland School of Social Work, a demonstrated ability to pursue a rigorous research agenda with commensurate publications and external funding with emphasis on mental health research. Preference is given to candidates presenting a capacity for effective teaching and student service/engagement and evidence of collaborating with stakeholders and capacity for leadership in research, teaching and service activities. An MSW from a CSWE-accredited program and a minimum of two years post-MSW professional experience is preferred.   Salary is commensurate with experience and qualifications.

jobs.description: Baylor University seeks a visionary leader and accomplished scholar to serve as the inaugural Chair of the School of Earth and Environmental Sciences (SEES). The Chair will play a central role in developing and advancing an integrated vision for research, education, and program expansion aligned with Baylor’s goals as a nationally recognized R1 institution. The Chair will demonstrate a commitment to Baylor's mission as a Christian research university. The new School, established in June 2026, is being formed through the integration of the Departments of Environmental Science and Geosciences and builds on established strengths across a broad range of earth and environmental systems research and teaching.
